name: application-shell-frontend

stack.hydration_model: SSR-first shell with selective Leptos/WASM island mounting; interactive surfaces keep local state and fetch permitted render envelopes when context changes.
stack.island_entrypoint: mount_dashboard_islands() exported from the WASM package

api_contract_codegen.status: declared-client-recipe; shell consumes the locked Rust shell-BFF production contract source in src/shell_capability_registry.rs

dev_commands.name: preferred local dev server
dev_commands.notes: Uses the crate-local cargo-leptos metadata and the SSR feature to run the local console shell at 127.0.0.1:3000.

dev_commands.name: documented local dev server without cargo-leptos
dev_commands.notes: Launches the crate-local SSR dev server at 127.0.0.1:3000 and serves /api/render-envelope/<context-id> for selective island refreshes; cargo-leptos remains the preferred watcher when installed.

dev_commands.name: documented build equivalent when cargo-leptos is not installed
dev_commands.command: cargo test -p application-shell-frontend && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p application-shell-frontend --release && cargo build -p application-shell-frontend --no-default-features --features ssr
dev_commands.notes: Builds and tests the Leptos/WASM shell without launching a dev server.

runtime_boundaries: panel data is contract-enveloped through the locked shell-BFF production contract source; the browser never receives a full capability catalog
token brokerage uses the shell token-broker port and deployment-specific OIDC adapters
no PHI, PII, or customer tenant payloads are bundled in the static contract envelope
workflow execution, external send, and cloud mutation require deployment adapters outside this crate

rendering_security.model: server-derived render envelope over a deny-by-default capability registry
rendering_security.capability_registry: src/shell_capability_registry.rs exposes shell-bff-contract-source:v1 from shared-platform-contracts-kernel::shell_bff locked contracts; validate_registry() is enforced in tests

implemented_files.capability_registry: src/shell_capability_registry.rs — locked-contract CapabilityRegistryEntry/ModuleRouteRegistration rows; module cards derive deny-by-default per operator context
implemented_files.hydrated_state: src/client_session_state.rs stores active permitted context/session state only
implemented_files.server_endpoint: src/main.rs serves /api/render-envelope/<context-id> only in the SSR dev server
implemented_files.wasm_island: src/app.rs DashboardIsland fetches one permitted envelope at a time; the full capability registry never ships to the browser as a catalog

rendering_security.context_switching: Context buttons are inside a selective Leptos/WASM island. The browser requests /api/render-envelope/<context-id>; the server derives and serializes only the permitted TenantRenderEnvelope for that tenant/role/accreditation context.

selective_wasm_islands.ssr_shell: Header, hero, scope notice, and initial dashboard HTML are server-rendered and useful before WASM loads.
interactive_scope: workflow node inspection, mode switching, visual block insertion, and simulation preview
Messenger channel switching, item inspection, and local draft queueing
Mail compose preview and local draft queueing
Community topic inspection and local post draft queueing
selective_wasm_islands.deny_by_default_invariant: module visibility is deny-by-default from the capability registry; an unpermitted capability is absent from the envelope, never greyed out client-side

rendering_security.adapter_required_for_mutation: Workflow block additions, mode switching, hub channel switching, item inspection, and draft queueing are functional in local WASM state; backend mutation, external send, or workflow execution requires a configured deployment adapter.

forbidden_fallbacks: client-side hiding of unauthorized modules as a security model
implemented_surfaces: permitted module catalog from the locked capability-registry contract
cohesive Workflow Studio with palette, canvas, inspector, mode toolbar, local visual block insertion, and simulation preview
built-in Messenger with local thread selection and draft queueing
built-in Mail with local compose/draft queueing
built-in Community spaces with local post draft queueing
